/*** Blog Listing Featured Slider ***/
.slider_post_wrapper {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 1s ease;
  -webkit-transition: opacity 1s ease;
}

.slider_post_wrapper.slick-initialized {
  visibility: visible;
  opacity: 1;    
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_img_wrapper {
  width: 60%;
  float: left;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: 50% 50%;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  min-height: 437px;
  position: relative;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_img_wrapper a {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body {
  width: 40%;
  float: right;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 437px;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body p {
  -webkit-transition: all 200ms ease;
  -moz-transition: all 200ms ease;
  transition: all 200ms ease;  
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner {
  background-color: #f1f5fe;
  padding: 30px;
  border: none;
  min-height: 437px;
  -webkit-transition: all 200ms ease;
  transition: all 200ms ease;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner h2.featured_title{
  color: {{ linkColor }};
  font-size: 32px;
  line-height: 36px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_posts:hover .featured_body_inner {
  background-color: #eaeef6;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner p{
  color: #000 !important;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner .preview_text h1,
.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner .preview_text h2,
.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner .preview_text h3,
.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner .preview_text h4{
  color: #000;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5em;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  display: none;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner .readmore-wrapper {
  display: -ms-inline-flexbox;
  display: inline-flex;
  -ms-flex-wrap: wrap;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-weight: 600;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 24px;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_body_inner .readmore-wrapper .readmore svg {
  height: 19px;
  width: 20px;
  margin-left: 10px;
  transition: .15s ease-in-out;
}

.hs-blog-listing .featured_posts:hover .featured_body_inner .readmore-wrapper .readmore svg{
  margin-left: 15px;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper button.slick-prev{
  left: 0;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper button.slick-next {
  right: 41.2%;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slick-prev:before, 
.hs-blog-listing .slick-next:before {
  font-family: 'FontAwesome'!important;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slick-prev:before {
  content: '\f104'!important;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slick-next:before {
  content: '\f105'!important;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper button.slick-arrow {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  margin-left: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #505050;
  border-radius: 200px;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  color: silver;
  z-index: 1;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper ul.slick-dots {
  top: 28px;
  right: initial;
  left: 63.6%;
  width: auto;
  bottom: initial!important;
  padding: 0;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper .slick-dots li{
  width: 25px;
  height: 2px;
  margin: 0 4px;
  background-color: rgba(34,34,34,0.3);
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper .slick-dots li button:before{
  display: none;
}

.hs-blog-listing .slider_post_wrapper .slick-dots li.slick-active{
  background-color: #7A7A7A;
}

.hs-blog-listing .main_section .slick-dotted.slick-slider{
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
